models_evaluated: AI-augmented kidney stone composition test V1

links.outcome: Model concordance on AI-influenced vs human-only reference labels
links.effect: V2 had 10% lower concordance than V1 on AI-influenced production hold-out set, similar on pre-AI set, but outperformed V1 on human-only or human-corrected labels, especially for less-common stone types.
links.quote: These findings revealed an AI label feedback loop, confounding retraining and evaluation.

unlisted_practices: Maintain ongoing human-only annotation of a case subset to prevent AI label feedback loops when retraining and evaluating deployed models
